summary: Introduce deterministic retention policies, cryptographic legal holds, export archives, and transactional deletion lifecycle with deletion receipts.

migration.note: Existing target repositories manage legacy records through explicit records-lifecycle Inventory, Export, and Purge workflows; unmanaged legacy records remain preserved until policy-evaluated.

compatibility.note: Adds retention policy evaluation, signed legal hold envelopes, and transactional purge commands without mutating existing installer or update contracts.
